title: Vectorized 1-NN Distance Network
prompt:
Implement three NumPy helpers for a vectorized 1-nearest-neighbor classifier.

`predict_1nn_l2(queries, train_points, train_labels)` should predict the label of the closest training point under squared L2 distance. Use NumPy vectorization over all query/training pairs; do not write a Python loop over queries.

`l2_distance_logits(queries, train_points)` should return logits whose `argmax(axis=1)` gives the same nearest training index as L2 1-NN. Use the identity `-||q - x||^2 = 2 q dot x - ||x||^2 - ||q||^2`, and omit the query-only term because it is shared across every training point.

`predict_1nn_l1(queries, train_points, train_labels)` should predict under L1 distance. This may materialize pairwise absolute differences. Ties should follow NumPy `argmin` / `argmax` behavior: choose the first training point.

example.reasoning: The query is closer to the second training point by L2 and L1 distance.
